January 15, 1931
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 655
Late 13.1.31

DISSOLUTION OF LABOUR UNIONS

The Social Daily News, a mosquito
newspaper, (Address: corner of Pakhoi and Thibet Rds.)
publishes the following article:-
The National Government and the
Central Kuomintang Headquarters have determined to
dissolve the various labour unions in Shanghai.
As the Shanghai Special District
Kuomintang failed sometime ago to observe the order
of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters to dissolve
the Shanghai Postal Employees' Union, the Central
Kuomintang Headquarters will issue a strict order
that all labour unions in Shanghai, such as the
Shanghai Postal Employees' Union, the Railway Employees'
Union, the Commercial Press Employees' Union, the
B.A.T, Workers' Union, the Union of Workers of the
French Tramway, Electricity, and Waterworks Company,
the Union of Workers of the Shanghai Tramway Company,
the Union of Workers of the Shanghai Waterworks Co.,
The Shanghai Newspapers Vendors' Union, etc. (altogether more than
400 labour unions) must be dissolved. The Central
Kuomintang Headquarters will also request the Chinese
military and political authorities in Shanghai to render
assistance in carrying out the order and, when necessary,
the Settlement authorities will be requested to help.
This matter greatly concerns the peace and
order of Shanghai. There are approximately
300,000 workers in Shanghai who naturally oppose the
dissolution of their unions. The Nanking authorities
are anticipating that the workers might start a
struggle and that Communists might take advantage of
the opportunity to instigate the postal workers,
railway workers, newspaper office workers, water and
electricity workers and other industrial workers to
go on strike. Despite the serious nature of the
matter, the Government Authorities will decidedly carry
out its decision to dissolve all the labour unions in
Shanghai. General Chiang Kai Shek is paying great
attention to this matter, and Soong Tse Ven, Kooong
Tsiang Shi, Yu Han Min, and other prominent members of
the National Government are all of the opinion that if
the labour unions in Shanghai are not dissolved, Chinese
industry and commerce will go bankrupt. Surprising
events are expected immediately the Shanghai authorities
receive the order to dissolve the labour unions.

Reg.
Please keep. A copy has been
sent to SI for attention.
M.G.
15/1/31.

1931年1月15日
上海公共租界工部局
刑事与特别股登记处
编号 S. B. D. 655
1931年1月13日晚

解散工会

《社会日报》，一家微不足道的小报，（地址：北西藏路与派克路转角）刊登了以下文章：
国民政府与中国国民党总部已决定解散上海各工会。
由于上海特别区党部此前未能遵守中国国民党总部关于解散上海邮务工会的命令，中国国民党总部将发布严令，要求解散上海所有工会，如上海邮务工会、铁路员工工会、商务印书馆职工会、英美烟厂工会、法商电车电灯自来水公司工人联合会、上海电车公司工人联合会、上海自来水公司工人联合会、上海报贩工会等（共计400多个工会）必须予以解散。中国国民党总部还将请求上海的军政当局协助执行该命令，并在必要时请求租界当局提供协助。
此事关系到上海的治安秩序。上海约有30万工人，他们自然会反对解散其工会。南京当局预计工人可能会发起斗争，共产党可能会利用这一机会煽动邮务工人、铁路工人、报馆职员、水电工人及其他产业工人罢工。尽管事态严重，政府当局仍将坚决执行解散上海所有工会的决定。蒋介石将军对此事高度重视，宋子文、孔祥熙、于右任等国民政府要员均认为，如果上海工会不解散，中国工商业将会破产。预计上海当局一旦收到解散工会的命令，立即就会发生惊人事件。

登记。
请存档。副本已送交情报处（SI）注意。
M.G.
1931年1月15日。
